posts.title: The Research Agenda
posts.description: Seven open topics, every claim tagged with the kind of evidence behind it, and for each topic the result that would close it. Most of them have people working on them. What is missing is the connection.

posts.title: The Predictions Ledger
posts.description: Fifty-six dated bets, how to score them, and why most of them cannot show that the author knows anything. Nobody has agreed to do the scoring.

posts.title: Who Pays to Keep It True?
posts.description: A theorem stays proved when the money stops. An encoded statute keeps answering, and goes wrong. Mathlib shows how a formal library is kept. It cannot show who should pay when somebody else holds the clock.
